hint: Requires AutoJs6 {{ required_host_version_name }} ({{ required_host_version_code }}) or later
feature: Batch renaming of files and folders in the AutoJs6 file manager (entries: multiple-selection toolbar/folder menu "Batch rename items inside"/"More" menu of the rename dialog)
Search and replace with plain text or JavaScript regular expressions, every match, case sensitivity, and renaming of only the name or the extension
Counters, date variables from the modification time or the current time, random strings and UUIDs
Case conversion, Unicode normalization, full-width to half-width, replacement of characters that are not allowed, trimming of surrounding spaces and numbering that continues existing names
Preview of the new names before renaming, per-item exclusion or only the items that change, and a choice to refuse, skip, add a number or replace the existing entry when a new name is taken
Undo of recent rename batches (AutoJs6 keeps the last 20, shared by the file manager and scripts)
Computes the new names for the files.batchRename script API of AutoJs6
The screen follows the AutoJs6 theme color, dark mode and language, and can remember the last options and recent search and replace texts
dependency: Attach Rhino (the slim AutoJs6 build, for regular expressions)
